title: Offers: optional Invoice description under Invoice to
text: Create Offer has a new optional box, Invoice description, under Invoice to. What you type is printed on the offer's invoice exactly as written (up to 200 characters), for example when a lead pays with his own company. Left empty, the invoice keeps the automatic wording, so existing offers do not change.
points: It is private: never shown on the offer page the client sees.
It is kept when an offer is revised, and used for the signing invoice, staff Confirm payment and the later parts of a payment plan.
